technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with long-term bullish structure conflict with weak momentum, poor price positioning relative to short-term MAs, and lack of volume confirmation—recovery bounce possible but insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: LHX shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 87 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (18/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional selling and absent news sentiment limit conviction; market capitulation signal dominates.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (440), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinationals, FOMC event in 2 days, and earnings 87 days out create compounded uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9) with long-term EMA 50/200 bullish structure and supertrend confirmation creates technical bounce setup in fear-driven market capitulation zone.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis (VIX 440, FOMC in 2 days, flat yield curve), price below all short-term MAs, zero volume confirmation, weak momentum (MACD bearish, CMF negative, OBV flat), and high earnings risk in 87 days create compounded headwinds that overshadow oversold technicals.
